name: Beyond Finance
desc:
Client Retention Specialist | $19 - $20/hr + commission | Inbound, Sales/Retention
Company: Beyond Finance
Industry: Financial Services / Debt Relief
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be answering inbound calls from people who are already enrolled in a debt relief program but are having second thoughts or getting frustrated with the process. Your job is to calm them down, listen to what's actually bothering them, and help them see the value in sticking with the program instead of dropping out. You're part counselor, part problem solver, and part salesperson, since you're working toward retention goals and can earn commission based on how many clients you keep enrolled. It's emotionally demanding work since you're dealing with people under real financial stress, but it's also relationship driven rather than cold selling.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: Experience in Retention, Sales, or Collections
Preferred Experience: Associate's or Bachelor's degree
Required Skills:
Ability to negotiate and deescalate client issues effectively
Strong verbal and written communication and active listening
Proficiency with a CRM system
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time in a fast-paced, high call volume environment
Resilience and composure under pressure
Troubleshooting and problem solving skills
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with prior sales, retention, or collections experience who is comfortable working toward targets
Someone emotionally resilient who can stay calm with upset or stressed callers
Someone who genuinely enjoys helping people find a path forward, not just closing a transaction
Someone comfortable with a commission component tied to performance
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone without sales, retention, or collections experience, this is listed as required
Anyone who finds high call volume or emotionally charged conversations draining rather than energizing
Anyone who needs a fully fixed hourly income with no performance component
Anyone uncomfortable with the sales and negotiation side of a "retention" role
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Client retention
Sales
Collections
Deescalation
CRM systems
Customer service
Negotiation
Financial hardship programs
Active listening
High call volume
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you deescalated an upset or frustrated customer. What did you say or do that worked?
This role involves retention goals and commission. How do you feel about your pay being tied to performance?
Walk us through how you'd handle a client who wants to quit a program you believe is helping them.
Describe your experience with CRM systems and keeping detailed client records.
How do you take care of yourself after a string of emotionally difficult calls?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $19 to $20 per hour base, plus commission tied to retention goals
Shift: Not specified in the posting
Benefits: Employer contributions toward health, dental, and vision, generous PTO, paid holidays, paid parental leave, 401(k) matching, and career development programs
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes:  Required experience in Retention, Sales, or Collections is a real filter, not a nice to have.This role is a great fit for someone who likes helping people through tough moments and turning things around for them. If a participant has sales, retention, or collections experience and enjoys real conversations over scripted ones, this is a chance to build a genuine skill set in negotiation and client relationships, with commission on top of base pay for those who perform well. Strong active listening and a calm, steady phone presence go a long way here.
Career Pathway: Client Retention Specialist → Senior Retention Specialist → Team Lead or Client Success Manager
training: Discussed in interview/offer stage- have open availability
